html: † אַשְׁמַנִּים (elative, Ges§ § 85b, 133a; on נּ v. Id. §§ 20a, 93ee) appar. n.[m.]pl. בָּא׳ כַּמֵּתִים Is 59:10 perhaps: (we are) among the stout (RV lusty) like dead men, cf. Di-Kit; or abstr. in (actual) vigour (Buhl) > AV (after Jos Ki from אָשַׁם Ho 14:1 ‘be desolate’) in desolate places (other conj. v. CheHpt Marti).
